timing: Before global prediction seal and before any AG clustering evaluation score. Training already running.
primary_endpoint: ACC on unqueried objects at Q=400
descriptive: All ten paired seed differences; mean and sample SD. Retain every prespecified seed.
test: Two-sided exact paired sign-flip test of the absolute mean difference, enumerating all 2^10 sign assignments; inclusive tail within 1e-12 percentage points.
assumptions: Tests conditional on this fixed corpus and prespecified seed-generating procedure, under within-pair exchangeability of the two algorithm outcomes. Not a test over independent corpora; no universal algorithm dominance inference.
multiplicity: Holm adjustment across exactly these three ACC comparisons, family alpha .05. Report all three raw and adjusted p values, regardless of direction.
other_endpoints: NMI, ARI, Q=0/160 and BER are descriptive; no further significance tests.
failures: Only perform a comparison test if all ten paired final predictions meet their declared numerical eligibility; otherwise report test not performed with count, and retain terminal descriptive scores separately.
no_selection: Neither statistics nor evaluation labels change the model, grid, seeds, data, or candidate selection.
